title: 💻 Mission 3 — Password Validator
subtitle: Assess a password against five Morpheus Security Systems rules.
instructions:
Your mission: complete the password validation logic.

The program must check that the password:
• is at least 12 characters long;
• contains at least one uppercase letter;
• contains at least one lowercase letter;
• contains at least one digit; and
• contains at least one special character that is not a letter, digit or space.

The program must then display:
• WEAK — passes 0 to 3 rules;
• MODERATE — passes 4 rules;
• STRONG — passes all 5 rules.
